info.title: VMS planned frontend HTTP API
info.description: APPROVED PLANNING BASELINE ONLY. 38 business operations, D01-D100 and the reviewed technical proposals. User approved the planning freeze on12 November2026 WITA. No application, database/container, migration or deployment authorization; no runtime correctness claim. Reference-first future decision policy and recorded development/release gates remain.

Checked-in only, late checkout supported. D96 allows successful-checkin consumed QR after admission expiry, unless revoked; manual code alternative. Atomically append one checkout.

No attendance side effect. Status-specific QR validation: D96 consumed/nonrevoked QR resolves its checked-in visit after admission expiry. Restricted arrival projection never enters ordinary reception cache.

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: Must exactly match configured staff origin; URI syntax alone grants no authority.

BusinessId.description: D95: canonical decimal PostgreSQL INTEGER ID, 1 through 2147483647. Not a booking code or service ID.

Version.description: D97: positive PostgreSQL INTEGER conflict version. Exhaustion rejects mutation; never wrap/reset.

StartTime.description: Start only, Asia/Makassar. Must be in future on creation/schedule edits; end may exceed 16:00.

Email.description: One ASCII mailbox, no display-name/list/header input; trimmed, normalized per D82. Validate local/domain syntax and lengths.

Password.description: New password: >=15 code points AND <=72 UTF-8 bytes; bcrypt, no truncation/prehash.

ExistingPassword.description: Verify existing credential; new-password minimum is not imposed on current-password/login verification.

Reference.description: UUID request/submission/upload reference, distinct from a business ID.

Credential.description: Manual eight-digit code or opaque QR. Admission and checkout have different eligibility; D96 permits the QR consumed on successful check-in for checkout after admission expiry, unless revoked.

x-accepted-formats.qr: Proposed vmsq1. prefix plus43 unpadded base64url characters from32 random bytes; no embedded person/booking data.

x-server-invariants: Selected role belongs to availableRoles; current PG authority on every request.
Idle 8h; absolute 24h; refresh/polling never renew inactivity.

accessToken.description: Sensitive response credential held only in memory; never a URL/log/persistent browser-store value.

Attachment token and display name refer to same verified owned upload.

token.x-derived-format: Proposed vmsu1.<keyVersion>.<HMAC-SHA256-base64url>; keyVersion1..32 ASCII URL-safe characters. Dedicated key and immutable versioned derivation metadata (D99).

x-server-invariants: D99: same-reference accepted upload replay regenerates identical token using original dedicated key/version and immutable metadata, within original expiry.
No recoverable/plaintext upload token persisted; private lookup digest allowed. No new object quota or sliding expiry.
Complete editor replacement, not arbitrary partial merge; ordinary edit cannot set password/requirePasswordChange.
Preserve retained role metadata; official assignments toggle retained unique rows. Current authority, self-lockout/last-admin/anti-escalation checks.
SMTP field dictionary only for initial adapter; secret never has value.
Deferred storage metadata, if exposed, stays disabled with no writable provider fields.
SMTP fields unique by key; expose six known field descriptors, never duplicate keys or private paths.

x-provider-validation.tls: Verified CA/hostname, no insecure fallback; AUTH only after TLS
x-provider-validation.storage: Deferred settings not writable; no arbitrary preview endpoint/bucket keys.

x-server-invariants: Keys must belong to supported provider schema; no unsupported fields.
Omitted/blank configured secret keeps; explicit clear removes, reject required missing secret while enabled.
No secret echoes/logs; safe field-key errors.
Counts sum to total; other status counts zero for specific-status filter; exclude restricted before aggregation.
Inclusive dates, from<=to and elapsed range<=365 days; consistent authorized snapshot.
Scope/projection before filtering/counts; one consistent authorized snapshot.
Dashboard metrics required; first5 agenda plus first4 attention covered in deduplicated bounded union.

host.description: Optional while disabled. If effective enabled: valid nonempty ASCII DNS/punycode labels, no URL/port/userinfo; server-owned outbound allowlist and address validation.

port.description: Canonical decimal port 1-65535; blank only while disabled.

SmtpValues.description: SMTP-only patch values; omitted/blank configured password keeps existing. Validate merged effective configuration when enabled, not this partial object alone.

RefreshCookie.name: vms_refresh
RefreshCookie.description: Proposed concrete transport name; Secure HttpOnly host-only SameSite=Lax, persistent until absolute deadline.

SignedCSRF.name: X-VMS-CSRF
SignedCSRF.description: Proposed concrete header name; must equal signed readable cookie and validate session/anonymous binding; strict Origin checks also required.

CSRFCookie.name: vms_csrf
CSRFCookie.description: Proposed concrete readable host-only Secure SameSite=Lax cookie; must match header and valid signed binding, not merely be present.

AnonymousBinding.name: vms_login_binding
AnonymousBinding.description: Proposed concrete HttpOnly anonymous login binding from staff HTML delivery; fixed 30-minute lifetime.

x-unresolved: Reviewed physical/credential/SMTP/transport proposals are accepted planning specifications. Remaining implementation mechanics and final documentation generator/workflow are deferred to owning phases; reference-first policy remains.
Exact patch/dependency/image pins and runtime concurrency/streaming/SMTP/provider acceptance remain implementation gates, not completed tests.
Organization-owned domains, approved outbound targets, credentials, production retention/purge and document scanning/storage enablement remain separate release gates.

x-common-policy.publicRate: 120/min/trusted IP; additional operation limits in plan
x-common-policy.byteConstraints: x-max-utf8-bytes is server/frontend UTF-8 byte validation, not JSON Schema maxLength
x-common-policy.queryConstraints: x-query-schema validates parsed typed query object; reject repeated keys and keys from another view
x-common-policy.security: Cookie/header scheme names in this draft are review conventions; cookie binding/signature/Origin/PG authority cannot be established by OpenAPI alone.

x-planning-policy.referenceFirst: Inspect sihp-be actual owning source before each new decision question.
x-planning-policy.defer: If no applicable reference exists, queue nonurgent details for the owning BE development phase.
x-planning-policy.askNow: Only a concrete urgent VMS correctness/privacy/authorization/recovery or essential contract blocker.
x-planning-policy.priorSelections: D01-D100 retained; no application implementation authorization.
x-planning-policy.documentationWorkflow: Reference generates Swagger2 from Go annotations. Approved VMS OpenAPI3.1 is the planning contract; final generator/tool/synchronization workflow remains a development-phase choice.

x-approval.scope: Planning documents only, including reviewed schema/credential/SMTP/transport proposals.
